notes.title: MXGP2019 - New patch released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35229240/f943f3fefc2edcf61cd1e13c1dc026c0356d8f0a.gif[/img]

Here we are again with a new patch. It fixes some bugs of the game like the official team bikes audio while playing as a custom rider and some minor bugs on online spectator mode.
But let's move on to the most important improvement of this patch: the "too fast" error on time attack is finally fixed.

notes.title: MXGP 2019 - New patch available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35229240/172fbcbc74632b025c4712f8edf4329fa8a4842a.jpg[/img]

New updates just released by our development team.
Now the bike settings can finally be loaded in multiplayer game modes! 😎
We also have:
☑️Added session timer on the qualify info session page.
☑️Fixed AI difficulty during qualify.
☑️Minor UI fixes.

☑️Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: MXGP 2019 - New Patch Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35229240/8d59c5b2525d8cd562ec2a4804891f517aa5dd96.png[/img]

Hi rider, we just have released a new patch and we're pretty sure you'll love it. 😁🤞
Thanks to your suggestions we have finally increased the maximum number of Waypoints that can be positioned from 20 to 100, but there is much more:
- New Custom Tracks online voting on Private Match.
- Tweaked bike physics in order to reduce understeering and sliding effects.
- Fixed Mitchell Evans nationality.
- Fixed a bug that caused a crash when exiting from a Custom Track race after the Online Races.
- Fixed Thor Radial boots issues.
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: MXGP 2019 - New patch available
notes.content:
Hi Riders,

finally a new update is came out and we are pretty sure you will look forward to downloading it. 

The new patch improves the MXGP 2019 gaming experience even further, introducing some important features, strongly expected from the community…

As promised, the Palembang track is now available, we have all missed it, but now you can finally compete in this new track. Another important newness is coming: the introduction of a new scenario, available for the Track Editor, we can finally welcome the new Pacific environment!

For those who love challenges, you will be glad to know that online qualifications and Custom Tracks in private online lobbies are now available.

Below you will find the complete changelog of this patch note.

– Added MXGP of Indonesia (new Palembang track).

– Added Pacific as a new environment for the Track Editor.

– Added Custom Tracks to online private lobbies.

– Added online qualifications.

– Improved overall game stability.

– Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: MXGP 2019 - Features Unveiled
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35229240/172fbcbc74632b025c4712f8edf4329fa8a4842a.jpg[/img]

Two long awaited features of MXGP 2019 are today unveiled: the Track Editor and a brand-new game mode, The Waypoint!

[h1]TRACK EDITOR[/h1]
For the first-time in the MXGP history, you will have a Track Editor to create your favorite track fully customized with specific Motocross modules. But that’s not all! You can also select different environments where to set the track, all with different features like woods, desert, riviera and other available shortly after the D1. And share your tracks with your friends to compete with them!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35229240/cbc2b226ef91873ecfd59dc033b63bfbfe9a9a3e.jpg[/img]


[h1]WAYPOINT[/h1]
Set inside the Playground, where players can freely roam, the Waypoint will allow you to design your own off-road path, putting checkpoints on the ground, to race them across to set the best lap. Then, you can share your creation to challenge the Community! Endless user generated challenges, to find out who’s the king of the Playground!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35229240/e7c7e3901cc4556936e3cf3dde44a1ed52649710.jpg[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iZ7wHXYUqS0
Globally available from August 27th on PlayStation®4, Xbox One and Windows PC®/STEAM, MXGP 2019 will allow you to race with all riders, bikes and teams of the current season at the tracks of the 2019 calendar.
